review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; tools/autopilot/AUDIT.md read for local rendering-audit context.

review_method.source_snapshot_html: Reviewed all 51 titles and complete ItemBodies against assignment snapshots and local HTML; current sources, snapshots, and local HTML match assignment SHA256 values. Screenshot tiles were reviewed in source order at the receipt crop positions.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, or publication-status edits; no live website, network, build, test, gate, commit, or push. Only lane-09.md and lane-09.json are report outputs.

optional_typography.observation: No literal TeX/TikZ, ASCII-math leakage, clipping, missing glyph, or KaTeX rendering defect was confirmed. The prose and formulas visible in the local captures match the corresponding ItemBodies; receipt reports zero KaTeX errors and zero diagram failures.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The example explicitly contrasts a confounding fork with a collider. These are canonical, visually useful DAG structures and the item uses the graphs to frame its conditional-probability calculations. A two-panel drawing can expose the key relation without adding assumptions.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Panel 1: nodes U,E,A,Y; arrows U→A, E→A, U→Y; annotate A=U xor E and Y=U, with A←U→Y as the open backdoor path and conditioning on U blocking it. Panel 2: B→D←C, annotate D=B∨C and show conditioning on D=1 activates dependence between B and C. Keep calculations and proof independent of the drawing.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; source formulas and verification are already clear.
